title: Watch face does not sync from Android Aaps to Watch?
symptom: After installing latest AAPS wear 3.3.1.2 on Samsung G6 Watch via Wear2 app, the user cannot re-install/send the custom watch face from the phone; selecting a watch face on the phone does nothing on the watch.
cause: The user had not selected the AAPS Custom watch face on the watch itself.
fix: Select the AAPS (Custom) watch face on the watch, then go to Wear on the phone to select the desired watch face.
evidence_quote: I specifically need to select the custom watch face.. somehow i was looking for a menu option..or so...
